name: The New…Me?
source:
As if high school isn’t hard enough. What happens when you swap bodies with the popular guy at school? The one person you truly hate. Will you be able to get your own body back?

translation:
高中生活本就已经够让人头疼了。可要是你偏偏和学校里的风云校草——那个你打心底里深恶痛绝的死对头——互换了身体，又会发生什么？你究竟能否找回属于自己的身体？
